title: tc-confidence-brief
description:
An answer explained for someone who wasn't in the session: the conclusion, the kind of uncertainty, what would
change it, the key assumptions, signs to watch, the track record and the provenance record – with Copy as text.

heading.description: The heading – what the brief is about, often the question as it was asked

meta.description: A quiet line under the heading: when it was prepared, for whom

question.description: The question as it was asked, quoted above the conclusion

conclusion.description: What we conclude, in a sentence or two

confidence.description: How confident the conclusion is – shown beside it; unset shows no level

confidenceLabels.description: Names of the three levels – "High confidence", "Moderate confidence" and "Low confidence" by default

uncertainty.description: The kinds of uncertainty behind the conclusion: "data", "model", "disagreement", "time"

uncertaintyLabels.description: Names of the four kinds – "Data", "Model", "Disagreement" and "Time" by default

uncertaintyNote.description: A sentence on why it's uncertain, under the labels

basis.description: What the conclusion rests on, in plain words – the kinds of source and how recent, not their names

assumptions.description: The assumptions the conclusion depends on

signals.description: Things to watch for that would call the conclusion into question

record.description: How often similar conclusions turned out right

provenanceId.description: The provenance record's reference; set, the brief shows it and fires tc-provenance-open when it's pressed

provenanceLabel.description: What the provenance reference is called

copyLabel.description: The label of the copy button
